== PC Discord and Retro Club facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the count of 36 players entered when the league went live, from Jared Napolitano's forum post of 11 February 2022 and Andy Talaga's Discord post (andytalaga in #retro-league-pc, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (15 February 2025), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/1190452472477655170/1340183140882190346 Discord message]).
=== Build notes ===
* The opening post gives 33 participants and the final standings list 33 players; the 11 February 2022 post says all 36 Event 1 players had been added, and the game 2 pairings post mentions "a few drops". Under the Retro League rule (sign-ups and pairings differ as players join and drop), both counts are kept: 36 entered, 33 in the standings.
